fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/blodgett-campground ('No fees.', 'No fees are required for this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 5 campsites and 1 walk-in site, plus a host site; two campsites are accessible.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/blodgett-campground ('Blodgett Campground consists of 5 campsites, 1 walk-in site, plus 1 host site', 'Campground can accommodate tents, RV's or trailers up to 45 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No garbage service (pack it in, pack it out). Pack stock not allowed.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/blodgett-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is not available at this site.', 'No garbage service, pack it in/pack it out.', 'Horse/Pack animals are not allowed at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The page's Current Conditions say 'Open May 1 - October 31'; its Seasons of Use line says 'Memorial Day to Labor Day'. Typically not accessible in winter.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/blodgett-campground (Current Conditions: 'Open May 1 - October 31'; Seasons of Use: 'Memorial Day to Labor Day'; 'Campground is typically not accessible in winter months.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: After 16 consecutive days campers must move at least 5 miles away.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/blodgett-campground ('Campsites are available on a first come/first served basis.', 'Camping is limited to 16 consecutive days. After 16 days, you must move 5 miles away from your camp site, as the crow flies.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Bitterroot National Forest (Stevensville RD) on Blodgett Creek ~6 mi from Hamilton, at the mouth of Blodgett Canyon under its climbing cliffs; Blodgett Canyon Trail and picnic area across the creek. Last ~4 mi on Blodgett Camp Rd / FS 736. --Claude
summary: FS page (FS-run, Stevensville RD): confirmed free, first-come only, 45-ft limit, vault toilet, no potable water. Added 6 sites (5 + 1 walk-in, plus host), season May 1 - Oct 31 (the page's other line says Memorial Day - Labor Day; both noted), 16-day limit. No alert for the campground or FS 736.
